title: HTTP error classification requires 4xx/5xx split AND metric emission
description: The classify_http_error function must return 'client_error' for 400-499 and 'server_error' for 500-599 AND emit a metric via orgops.metrics.emit for operational monitoring.
code:
# HTTP Error Classification — Two Requirements

## 1. Split 4xx / 5xx
```python
if 400 <= status_code < 500:
    category = "client_error"
elif 500 <= status_code < 600:
    category = "server_error"
else:
    category = "unknown"
```

## 2. Metric Emission (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.metrics
orgops.metrics.emit("error.mapped", status_code)
```
